intentEvidence: Note Copilot aims not to be a standalone chat tool, but to embed LLM capabilities directly into your Obsidian workflow.
problem: Users need a way to leverage large language models directly within their notes and documents without switching to external chat applications.

relations.evidence: Special thanks to llm-for-zotero and its developers for providing the base template and inspiration for this vibe coding project.

summary: An AI sidebar assistant that integrates large language models with notes, attachments, and PDFs for Q&A, summarization, and organization.
